articles.description: The RBI and the government are betting on foreign capital inflows rather than aggressive rate hikes to protect India's economy from rising crude oil prices. A potential $80-100 billion pipeline through FCNR deposits, ECBs and bond index inclusion could strengthen the rupee, ease liquidity pressures and support the bond market.
